question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**devastated**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The title of the given passage is 'Greedy Man'.
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is 'them'.
 
• ‘**Devastated**’ means extremely shocked and upset.
 
 
• *Example: They were **devastated** when their baby died.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

Correct Passage:__ *T**he greedy man rushed home to tell his wife and daughter about his wish, all the while touching the objects in his path and watching them convert into gold. Once he got home, his daughter rushed to greet him. As soon as he bent down to scoop her up in his arms, she turned into a golden statue. He was **devastated** and started crying and trying to bring his daughter back to life.*
